nodes.summary: Read a bit $b \in \{0, 1\}$ as the sign $\sigma(b)$, where $\sigma(0) = -1$ and $\sigma(1) = 1$. An $n \times t$ matrix $M$ with entries in $\{0, 1\}$ is a partial Hadamard matrix when its rows are pairwise orthogonal as sign vectors: for all distinct rows $i \ne i'$, $\sum_{j < t} \sigma(M_{ij}) \sigma(M_{i'j}) = 0$.

nodes.title: Leading-term counting exponent for partial Hadamard matrices

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $n$ and $t$, the de Launey–Levin leading term is the real number $A_{n,4t} = 2^{4nt + (n-1)^2} (8\pi t)^{-n(n-1)/4}$, where the power of $8\pi t$ is the real power function and $n - 1$ in the exponent of $2$ is truncated subtraction of natural numbers, so that $(n-1)^2 = 0$ when $n = 0$.
nodes.title: De Launey–Levin leading term

nodes.summary: For every natural number $n$, the number $N_{n,0}$ of $n \times 0$ partial Hadamard matrices is $1$: the orthogonality conditions are empty sums, so the empty matrix is the only one.
nodes.title: Width-zero partial Hadamard count

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $n$ and $t$, $N_{n,t}$ is the number of $n \times t$ partial Hadamard matrices, that is, of $n \times t$ matrices with entries in $\{0, 1\}$ whose rows are pairwise orthogonal when each entry $0$ is read as the sign $-1$ and each entry $1$ as the sign $1$.
nodes.title: Number of partial Hadamard matrices

nodes.summary: The sign of a bit $b \in \{0, 1\}$ is the integer $\sigma(b)$ given by $\sigma(0) = -1$ and $\sigma(1) = 1$.

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
